name: Smoothie glass
note: Tall with a wide mouth, because a thick pour needs a wide opening at both ends: room for the drink to leave the jug and room for a straw that will not clog.
iceDisplacementNote: Solid ice only, and rarely used — a blended drink brings its own. The figures are scaled from the same tall-glass ratios as the highball and Collins on this site rather than measured for this shape: cubed near 57% of capacity, a single block about 95% of that, crushed about a quarter more than cubed. Crushed is taken as 7% above cubed: loose crushed ice weighs about 593 to 640 kg per cubic metre against 917 for solid ice, roughly 65% solid, where loose cubes run about 61%.
